findings.text: follow-on: the done_when's clause that the files importing reckon/crew/node.py show no added failure against base is not measured — baseline_suite and after_suite name a nine-file dispatch subset, and the 162-file importer population is declared in follow_ons, so the coordinator's merge-time population run is still owed.

follow-on: the clive refusal is asserted only as the substring 'clive' in the error text, so a regression that replaced the lane refusal with any other CrewError mentioning the backend name would keep the test green.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base cc4e4a05; two commits, six files, +506 lines, all inside the declared scope · the production delta is the images field, three launch_plan call sites and the CLI option.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names four properties plus the importer-population clause; tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py exercises all four (two -i flags on a codex argv, the clive refusal by name, the --image CLI path, and the resume and change_lane argv), while the importer clause is declared rather than measured.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is to carry each node's figures through every launch path; reckon/crew/node.py:754 adds TaskNode.images and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1842, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1153 and :1589, and reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1259 thread it into launch_plan, so the goal is delivered as stated.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both commits (368ce9e17, 941c81d11), the 5-passed gate for the named test, base 79 passed / head 84 passed recorded to importer-base.log and importer-head.log, and the three-arm negative control to negative-control.log ending EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node was fenced to the five named files plus the evidence fragment and figure directory; every path in the diff (reckon/crew/node.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-can-see-the-figure/the-dispatch-carries-a-nodes-figures.html) is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py:324 reddens when the images are dropped at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1842, shown by arm 1 of negative-control.log, while the clive assertion at :343 is weaker.
justifications.evidence: importer-head.log ends "84 passed" and "EXIT=0" and is named in the manifest, but the nine-file subset it measured leaves the done_when's importer-population clause unmeasured.
justifications.fit: the images field mirrors peer_scopes at reckon/crew/node.py:753 as a default-empty list carried by as_dict, and no added name violates the repository naming rules.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/node.py:754 adds the images list and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1842 passes node.images to launch_plan, exactly as §6 states.
justifications.reuse: launch_plan's images parameter at reckon/_backends.py:2091 already owns the capability; the diff extends that owner rather than adding a second image path, and no new definition duplicates a capability the repository owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path, including the evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-can-see-the-figure/the-dispatch-carries-a-nodes-figures.html, is inside the node's fenced write paths and nothing the goal does not imply is carried.
